title: Draft: wslua: debugger: Introspect userdata (types, attrs, methods)
description:
Expose class metadata and members in the debugger variables model.

- Report variable types using wslua_typeof (__typeof) instead of plain "userdata"
  where applicable.
- Register instance method tables on the instance metatable as __methods so
  they can be enumerated without relying on __index upvalues.
- When a watched path resolves to full userdata, list attributes by invoking
  __getters via protected getfield, then instance methods from __methods, then
  static methods from the global class table; getter failures appear as type
  "error".
- Extend variable path resolution so dotted/bracket segments work through
  userdata (__index / gettable) using lua_pcall.
- Treat userdata as expandable when it has getters, instance methods, or
  class-level callables.

Ping #21193

AI-Assisted: yes
